sources.title: Anything agent documentation
sources.locator: Agent: code generation, modes, capabilities, threads and credits
sources.finding: The built-in agent edits React/React Native projects from requests. Threads have their own context and can be used in parallel. Max adds autonomous testing and background work. Model-provider choices do not identify the underlying coding harness.

sources.title: Anything CLI and server-side generation
sources.locator: Opening rollout notice; Authenticate; Async generation; When the wait runs long; Using with AI coding agents
sources.finding: The product CLI controls the same remote agent as the browser. It requires Node 24 and is rolling out to selected accounts. Browser login or an Anything API key authenticates it. A build continues on the server when the client wait times out. A bundled skill lets external coding agents drive the CLI; this does not make them the builder internal harness.

sources.title: Anything builder controls
sources.locator: Chat; Top bar; App preview; Version history; Text to build
sources.finding: The builder has prompt chat, a file-oriented Code tab, version restoration and a cloud-sandbox app preview. Mobile device frames show app output, not a separate ADE phone client. Text-to-build is a user-initiated Pro feature.

sources.title: Anything current subscription rules
sources.locator: Plans; Pricing; What happens when I downgrade to Free?; annual billing FAQ
sources.finding: The page explicitly requires a paid plan for new generations. Pro is $24 per month or an annual payment of $228, displayed as $19 per month equivalent. Free retains data and published work but pauses building. The dollar currency code is not stated on this page.

sources.title: Anything public pricing snapshot
sources.locator: Plans and Pricing; Monthly/Yearly selector; comparison
sources.finding: The rendered page shows annual-equivalent Pro and Max prices, credit plans and references to Free. It is read alongside the more explicit subscription rule, rather than interpreting its Free references as free ongoing generation.

sources.title: Anything credit billing
sources.locator: Opening; How credits work; Models; Managing credits
sources.finding: Generations consume plan credits according to task and model use. Monthly credits refill and expire at the billing boundary; top-offs do not expire. Model access in the builder is paid through Anything credits, separate from an external coding-agent subscription.

sources.title: Anything privacy policy
sources.finding: The policy discloses cookie-based analytics and browser-level cookie rejection. This does not establish a product control that stops all ADE usage or crash telemetry.
